title: Clicking Connect while the SSO web view is still loading deadlocks kded6 in OpenconnectAuthWidget::connectHost()
line: Clicking Connect again while an OpenConnect SSO login page is open no longer freezes kded; it restarts the login and shows the page again.
explanation: Clicking Connect again made the dialog wait for the login thread to stop, but that thread was waiting for the web view to finish, so both waited forever and all of kded froze. Releasing the web view (what MR !678 does) only fixes the freeze: the login then finishes as if it had succeeded and the dialog closes with no cookie, and a second web view made with the same profile name makes QtWebEngine spin and eat memory until kded is killed. The change releases the web view on reconnect, makes the web view callback report a cancelled login so libopenconnect stops cleanly, and reuses one web profile per dialog (the page now belongs to its view).

commits.message:
vpn/openconnect: don't freeze kded when reconnecting during SSO login

Connecting again while the SSO web view was open waited for the worker,
which was blocked on the web view, so kded hung. Release the web view,
cancel the login and reuse the web profile so the new login page loads.

BUG: 524348

media.caption: Pure master, after clicking Connect a second time while the sign-in page was loading: the page arrived from the server a minute later but the view stays blank, Cancel does nothing and kded6 no longer answers D-Bus.
With the fix, same steps: the second Connect restarts the login and the sign-in page loads; kded6 answers D-Bus throughout.
Pure master: Connect, Connect again while the page is loading, then Cancel; the dialog stays frozen for good.
With the fix: Connect, Connect again while loading; the login starts over and the sign-in page appears.

review.text: Good root-cause diagnosis that goes beyond open MR !678 to fix the deadlock, the missing cancellation status, and the duplicate QtWebEngineProfile spin/OOM on reconnect. However, reusing d->webEngineProfile as a child of OpenconnectAuthWidget introduces a QWebEngineProfile/QWebEnginePage destruction-order bug whenever the dialog is closed after a reconnect, and openWebEngineP() returns a form-result positive constant (+1) instead of a negative error code for libopenconnect's webview callback.
changes: Fix QWebEngineProfile vs QWebEnginePage destruction order on dialog close after reconnect: on a second openWebEngine() call, the new QWebEngineView (owning its QWebEnginePage) is created after d->webEngineProfile, so ~OpenconnectAuthWidget() (where deleteAllFromLayout() only calls deleteLater()) lets ~QObject() destroy d->webEngineProfile before the second page. Ensure all QWebEngineView/QWebEnginePage instances are destroyed before d->webEngineProfile (e.g. synchronously delete the web view before deleting an unparented profile in ~OpenconnectAuthWidget(), or unparent and deleteLater() the profile in the destructor).

Return a negative error code (e.g. -EINVAL or -1, matching validatePeerCert/writeNewConfig/openUri and libopenconnect's webview callback convention) instead of OC_FORM_RESULT_CANCELLED (+1, which is for process_auth_form) from OpenconnectAuthWorkerThread::openWebEngineP().
In ~OpenconnectAuthWidget(), set d->userQuit = true before releasing waitForWebEngineFinish (matching connectHost()) so the woken worker thread reliably observes cancellation.

reviews.text: The code is sound and goes beyond open MR !678: releasing the semaphore after setting userQuit, returning OC_FORM_RESULT_CANCELLED so libopenconnect stops cleanly, and reusing one profile with the page parented to its view fixes both the deadlock and the follow-on blank-view/QtWebEngine runaway, with gdb-backed before evidence and good regression coverage including a full SSO success. But its connectHost() hunk is identical to jpnssl's still-open !678, so submitting it as a separate MR would compete with an existing contributor's work. Minor: the destructor still releases the semaphore before setting userQuit, so the new post-acquire check can race there.
changes: Propose the two extra changes on MR !678 (or as a follow-up that credits its author) instead of a competing MR duplicating its hunk.
Optionally set d->userQuit = true before releasing the semaphore in ~OpenconnectAuthWidget too, matching connectHost().
